Which shortwave stations broadcast aimed at Europe?

In the A-26 schedule, 81 stations broadcast aimed at Europe. The most heavily scheduled include China Radio International, Radio Romania International, Voice of Korea, Voice of Vietnam.

What frequencies are used for shortwave broadcasts aimed at Europe?

The most-used frequencies are 13760, 12015, 15245, 9730, 6170 kHz. Which one is best depends on the time of day, the season and your location.

How can I listen without a shortwave radio?

Use a free WebSDR or KiwiSDR receiver in your browser. Our Listen Online page links to receivers and explains how to tune. Schedules are in UTC, so convert to your local time first.
